      @Deprecated EntitySoundPacket toEntitySoundPacket(UUID entityUuid, boolean whispering)
      Deprecated.
      use entitySoundPacketBuilder()
      Converts this packet to an entity sound packet.
      Parameters:
      entityUuid - the UUID of the entity
      whispering - if the entity is whispering
      Returns:
      the entity sound packet
      Throws:
      UnsupportedOperationException - if this is called on a packet created by VoicechatServerApi.createPacket()
